name: sendMessageWebhook
shortDescription: Sends a webhook notification to external systems when a new secure message is sent.
description:
Overview

Dispatches webhook notifications to external systems whenever a new secure Message is sent between a patient and a doctor.

Intended use

Invoked as an event handler whenever a Message record is created or updated. It receives the relevant Message data.

Logic

  1. Construct a payload containing relevant Message data (e.g., sender, receiver, conversation ID, timestamp, but excluding sensitive content unless explicitly configured) and the event type (e.g., 'message.created').
  2. Call the Webhook external service using ctx.service('Webhook').send to dispatch the notification to configured endpoints.
  3. Log the webhook delivery attempt and status (success/failure) using ctx.audit.log.

Entities

  • Message

External Services

  • Webhook
